text:
Type: ZZ plant in a nursery pot
Use: indoor greenery on the floor, a sideboard or a shelf; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: live plant with glossy waxy leaves, plastic nursery pot, potting soil
Colors: deep glossy green, terracotta brown pot
Shape: upright arching stems lined with oval pointed leaflets, bushy and tall above a compact pot, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, lush, natural, calm
Goes with: woven baskets, ceramic or metal cachepots, light wood, white walls; Scandinavian, bohemian or Japandi rooms
